title: A Multimodal Framework for the Detection of Hateful Memes

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative analysis of model misclassifications on memes targeting racial groups (e.g., Black people) and experiments utilizing external object detection tags to better capture target group information.
Qualitative evaluation of the model's errors (false negatives and false positives) on memes targeting religious identities, specifically noting failures to reason about groups like Muslims.
Qualitative analysis of model misclassification errors regarding memes that promote hate or discrimination based on gender.
Qualitative error analysis identifying the model's inability to recognize and correctly classify hateful multimodal content targeting individuals with disabilities, such as wheelchair users.
